name: kappa-intro
title: Meet the KAPPA, Japan's River Creature 🐢 #shorts
description:
In Japanese folklore, the kappa is a child-sized river creature with a turtle shell, webbed hands and a dish of water on its head. Spill the water and it goes weak, so the trick is to bow, because a kappa always bows back. One Edo-period naturalist probably drew his kappa from a real softshell turtle.

Would you bow or bring a cucumber? 👇

name: yeti
title: Could a YETI Actually Survive the Himalayas? 🏔️🐻 #shorts
description:
In Sherpa and Tibetan stories, the yeti is a huge, hairy walker of the high snow. Wide feet like a snowshoe hare, yak genes for thin air and a winter sleep like a brown bear get you most of the way there. Then DNA tests of nine "yeti" samples in 2017 found one dog and eight Asian bears, and the name itself means "rock bear".

Every step is based on a real animal. Which creature should we check next? 👇
